      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Remove the internal_bswap wrapper functions and call std::byteswap directly.",

      "id": "rc:4694953163",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "The std::views::zip loop in btck_chainstate_manager_import_blocks accesses path lengths unconditionally before verifying if path pointers are null.",
      "quote": "The zip loop reads a length before checking whether its path is null.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,

    {
      "id": "rc:4694955295",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Mention PR #36042 as a dependency because GCC 12 and NetBSD's libstdc++ 12 fail on features used here.",
      "quote": "GCC 12 and NetBSD's libstdc++ 12 fail on features this PR uses - maybe we could mention #36042 as a dependency.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,

    {
      "id": "rc:4694957195",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Use BOOST_REQUIRE instead of BOOST_CHECK before accessing error() or value() on expected objects in unit tests.",
      "quote": "The tests use BOOST_CHECK before accessing error() or value(), so a failed check continues into a wrong-state access.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],

    {
      "id": "rc:4694962976",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Cap'n Proto 0.9.2 headers fail to build under C++23 with GCC 14 and Apple Clang, requiring Cap'n Proto 1.0 when IPC is enabled.",
      "quote": "Cap'n Proto 0.9.2 headers fail with GCC 14 and Apple Clang in C++23.",

      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],

    {
      "id": "rc:4694968475",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Updating bundled libmultiprocess tests to use .contains() breaks its standalone build, which still targets C++20.",
      "quote": "Its standalone build still supports C++20, so changing those tests to `.contains()` here would break it.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",

    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4694969932",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Inline ContainsNUL to .contains('\\0'), adopt ranges::contains, and reuse GetWallet in loadwallet.",
      "quote": "ContainsNUL now only calls contains('\\0'), so I'd inline that check at its callers and remove the standalone fuzz call.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4694972072",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Adopt std::views::zip across other loops that only use integer indices to pair related containers.",
      "quote": "The block-import loop needs indexed access because null paths need no corresponding length. Elsewhere, five loops use an index only to pair entries from related containers.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4694974234",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Use std::to_underlying instead of casting enums manually via std::underlying_type_t.",
      "quote": "After the C++23 switch, network, RPC, tests, and the chainstate demo still cast enums through their underlying types. std::to_underlying expresses those conversions directly.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],

      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Avoid double scanning in strHelp by keeping the find newline position, and use contains for host-port colon and argsman checks.",

    {

      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Use std::optional::transform for transaction_identifier::FromHex and descriptor counts, and construct optional<XOnlyPubKey> directly in TapSatisfier::FromPKHBytes.",
      "quote": "transaction_identifier::FromHex and two descriptor counts can use optional::transform after C++23.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",

    {
      "id": "rc:4694981124",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Use std::ranges::fold_left instead of std::accumulate on block fee vectors.",

      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Update the RISC-V link test compilation and link flags from -std=c++20 to -std=c++23.",
      "quote": "The RISC-V link test still compiles and links its internal-header consumer as C++20. I'd update both flags to C++23 for this migration.",

      "id": "rc:4695026243",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",

      "quote": "Most hunks are ordinary C++20 cleanup and could land on master now.",

      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",

      "quote": "it would make sense to add a small compile sample for each to demonstrate support across our infrastructure - then handle the exhaustive call-site migrations in separate PRs.",

participants.note: supports concept but identified a block-import regression and IPC build breakages, along with numerous C++23 cleanup suggestions
noted an include change was due to IWYU heuristics

claims.text: Remove the internal_bswap wrapper functions and call std::byteswap directly.
claims.quote: The three internal_bswap functions now only forward to std::byteswap.

claims.text: The std::views::zip loop in btck_chainstate_manager_import_blocks accesses path lengths unconditionally before verifying if path pointers are null.
claims.quote: The zip loop reads a length before checking whether its path is null.

claims.text: Mention PR #36042 as a dependency because GCC 12 and NetBSD's libstdc++ 12 fail on features used here.
claims.quote: GCC 12 and NetBSD's libstdc++ 12 fail on features this PR uses - maybe we could mention #36042 as a dependency.

claims.text: Use BOOST_REQUIRE instead of BOOST_CHECK before accessing error() or value() on expected objects in unit tests.
claims.quote: The tests use BOOST_CHECK before accessing error() or value(), so a failed check continues into a wrong-state access.

claims.text: Cap'n Proto 0.9.2 headers fail to build under C++23 with GCC 14 and Apple Clang, requiring Cap'n Proto 1.0 when IPC is enabled.
claims.quote: Cap'n Proto 0.9.2 headers fail with GCC 14 and Apple Clang in C++23.

claims.text: Updating bundled libmultiprocess tests to use .contains() breaks its standalone build, which still targets C++20.
claims.quote: Its standalone build still supports C++20, so changing those tests to `.contains()` here would break it.

claims.text: Inline ContainsNUL to .contains('\0'), adopt ranges::contains, and reuse GetWallet in loadwallet.
claims.quote: ContainsNUL now only calls contains('\0'), so I'd inline that check at its callers and remove the standalone fuzz call.

claims.text: Adopt std::views::zip across other loops that only use integer indices to pair related containers.
claims.quote: The block-import loop needs indexed access because null paths need no corresponding length. Elsewhere, five loops use an index only to pair entries from related containers.

claims.text: Use std::to_underlying instead of casting enums manually via std::underlying_type_t.
claims.quote: After the C++23 switch, network, RPC, tests, and the chainstate demo still cast enums through their underlying types. std::to_underlying expresses those conversions directly.

claims.text: Avoid double scanning in strHelp by keeping the find newline position, and use contains for host-port colon and argsman checks.
claims.quote: strHelp.contains('\n') scans for the newline before find scans again.

claims.text: Use std::optional::transform for transaction_identifier::FromHex and descriptor counts, and construct optional<XOnlyPubKey> directly in TapSatisfier::FromPKHBytes.
claims.quote: transaction_identifier::FromHex and two descriptor counts can use optional::transform after C++23.

claims.text: Use std::ranges::fold_left instead of std::accumulate on block fee vectors.
claims.quote: fold_left can take each fee vector directly with the existing CAmount{0} seed.

claims.text: Update the RISC-V link test compilation and link flags from -std=c++20 to -std=c++23.
claims.quote: The RISC-V link test still compiles and links its internal-header consumer as C++20. I'd update both flags to C++23 for this migration.

claims.text: Land general C++20 cleanups separately on master, and only switch the atomic probe and NUMS_H lambda when bumping to C++23.
claims.quote: Most hunks are ordinary C++20 cleanup and could land on master now.

claims.quote: C++23 lets these four sites construct the view from the span directly.

claims.quote: it would make sense to add a small compile sample for each to demonstrate support across our infrastructure - then handle the exhaustive call-site migrations in separate PRs.

result.notes: Added extensive review feedback from l0rinc including an objection over a regression in block import path processing and Cap'n Proto C++23 build failures, alongside suggestions for various C++23 standard library modernizations.
